cache.mechanism: Next.js 16 unstable_cache / Data Cache; Vercel-managed persistence when deployed, no Redis
cache.homepageProgram: Both API adapters call the same cached homepage scraper
cache.semantics: Request-driven time revalidation. Expired content may be served while background revalidation runs; TTL is not a strict maximum data age. Failed revalidation retains the previous validated entry while that entry exists.
cache.coldMisses: Concurrent calls to the same source module coalesce through a temporary promise; no distributed cold-miss lock.
cache.validation: Only successful validated DTOs enter Data Cache. Errors/fallback labels are outside cache. Raw upstream fetch is deliberately no-store to avoid caching HTTP 200 bot/error HTML. No additional route/CDN cache layer.
cache.excluded: Personal/admin data, Supabase, and live audio are not cached by this implementation

polling.behavior: Pause/abort hidden; resume once; skip admin routes; abort on unmount; one pending request; schedule next interval after completion; ignore redundant visibility notifications; preserve last title on request failure

compatibility.aboutFailure: Now returns HTTP 500 with members/aboutBackgrounds arrays rather than HTTP 200 empty content
compatibility.dynamicContent: Removed invented homepage quote and outdated December 2025/tagline fallback. No replacement official content is invented.
compatibility.schedule: One initial request feeds title and grid; existing CSV splitting algorithm retained; refresh 60 seconds after prior request completes

mockCounts.scenario: Two sequential passes over all six APIs within TTL; mocked upstreams
mockCounts.baselineMethod: Replay with cache backend disabled to reproduce previous uncached request behavior
mockCounts.cacheMethod: Installed Next unstable_cache with a deterministic mock storage backend

lint.command: npm run lint (also executed by prebuild)

productionSmoke.repeatedReason: Initial new visibility test failed; fixed redundant visibility handling and restored native visibility before navigation, then repeated smoke to verify.
productionSmoke.persistentCache: Second independent production server reused the first server Data Cache without fetching the homepage again

validationResults.isolation: Upstream HTTP, browser external requests and media use local fixtures. No live upstream load tests, database migration, or deployment. Mock-created fetch-cache entries removed after smoke.

remaining: Durable last-known-good storage is deferred; cache eviction/absence plus upstream outage still yields the existing generic failure/fallback contracts.
Vercel-managed cache behavior is based on the supported Data Cache mechanism; no Vercel deployment or cross-region live verification was performed.
Cold misses in separate instances can still overlap; rate limiting and distributed coordination were not implemented.
Existing HTML selectors, CSV parsing limitations, and podcast category labels remain for a later phase.
Physical device playback, real upstream content changes and PWA service-worker lifecycle were not tested in this phase.
